item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Anthropic拟10月IPO、Gemini 3.1 Flash上线、Cursor推实时RL技术
item.description:
标签: #AI行业 #大模型 #IPO #智能体

摘要: Anthropic正考虑最早于10月进行IPO，估值或超600亿美元；同时Google发布实时语音模型Gemini 3.1 Flash Live，Cursor则通过实时强化学习技术实现编程助手的高频迭代更新。

原标题: Anthropic weighs October IPO 💰, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 🎙️, Cursor real-time RL 🔄

TLDR AI 2026-03-27

Anthropic weighs October IPO 💰, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 🎙️, Cursor real-time RL 🔄

Claude AI Maker Anthropic Considers IPO as Soon as October (2 minute read)

Anthropic is considering holding an initial public offering in October. The company has had early discussions with Wall Street banks on a potential listing. A listing could raise more than $60 billion. Deliberations are ongoing, and no final decisions have been made.

Anthropic 正考虑在十月进行 首次公开募股（IPO）。该公司已与华尔街银行就潜在上市事宜进行了初步磋商。此次上市可能筹集逾 600 亿美元。目前商议仍在进行中，尚未作出最终决定。

Elon Musk's X Restructures Ahead of SpaceX IPO (3 minute read)

X let go of its chief marketing officer and conducted a round of layoffs of nontechnical staff over the last several weeks. The company is right-sizing ahead of its parent company SpaceX's potential $1 trillion-plus IPO. Most of the remaining staff at X have been told to focus on growing the company's revenue. The company plans to launch a payments business, X Money, in early public access next month.

过去几周，X（原 Twitter）解雇了其首席营销官，并进行了非技术员工的裁员。在其母公司 SpaceX 潜在的 万亿美元以上 IPO 之前，该公司正在进行人员精简。X 的多数剩余员工被告知需专注于公司收入增长。该公司计划下个月初公开发布其支付业务 X Money。

Gemini 3.1 Flash Live for Real-Time Voice AI (2 minute read)

Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is a real-time voice model focused on low-latency, natural dialogue. It is available across Google's developer APIs, enterprise tools, and consumer products.

Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 是一款专注于低延迟、自然对话的实时语音模型。它现已通过 Google 的开发者 API、企业工具和面向消费者的产品提供。

The age of vertical models is here (9 minute read)

Fin, a customer service agent by Intercom, beats the best models in the industry, including GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.5. High-performing, fast, and cheap, the model consistently outperforms competitors while operating at a tremendous scale. It resolves almost 2 million customer issues per week. The model has already grown to nearly $100 million in recurring revenue.

Intercom 推出的客户服务智能体 Fin 击败了业内最顶尖的模型，包括 GPT-5.4 和 Opus 4.5。该模型性能高、速度快且成本低，在巨大规模运营的同时始终优于竞争对手。它每周解决近 200 万个客户问题，已实现近 1 亿美元的经常性收入。

Meet the Agents at USV (5 minute read)

USV built internal AI agents that ingest meeting transcripts, emails, and calendars to create structured “mentions” tied to companies and people, forming a continuously updated internal knowledge base. The system evolved from a simple meeting recap email into a custom CRM after existing tools failed to support real time context aggregation across workflows. USV improved adoption by naming agents, giving them roles and tool access, and embedding them directly into email threads where teams provide feedback that updates agent behavior.

USV（Union Square Ventures）构建了内部 AI 智能体（AI agents），这些智能体会摄取会议记录、电子邮件和日历信息，创建与公司和个人关联的结构化"提及"，形成一个持续更新的内部知识库。在现有工具无法支持跨工作流程的实时上下文聚合后，该系统从最初的简单会议回顾邮件演变为定制的 CRM（客户关系管理）系统。USV 通过为智能体命名、赋予其角色和工具访问权限，并直接将它们嵌入电子邮件线程中（团队可在其中提供反馈以更新智能体行为），提高了采用率。

👨‍💻

（工程师与研究章节分隔）

Engineering & Research

Improving Composer through real-time RL (7 minute read)

'Real-time RL' is a technique created by the Cursor team that involves using real inference tokens for training. The team serves model checkpoints to production, observes user responses, and aggregates those responses as reward signals. The approach allows them to ship an improved version of Composer as often as every five hours.

实时强化学习（Real-time RL）是由 Cursor 团队创建的一种技术，涉及使用真实推理令牌（inference tokens）进行训练。该团队将模型检查点部署到生产环境，观察用户响应，并将这些响应聚合为奖励信号。这种方法使他们能够每隔五小时就发布一个改进版的 Composer。

Cohere Releases Open Source Transcription Model (8 minute read)

Cohere's Transcribe is an open-source ASR model optimized for low word error rate and production use. It achieved top accuracy on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboard.

Cohere 的 Transcribe 是一个开源的 ASR（自动语音识别）模型，针对低词错误率和生产使用进行了优化。该模型在 Hugging Face Open ASR 排行榜上获得了最高准确率。

Chroma Context-1: Training a Self-Editing Search Agent (80 minute read)

Chroma Context-1 is a 20B parameter agentic search model trained on over eight thousand synthetically generated tasks. It achieves retrieval performance comparable to frontier models at a fraction of the cost and with up to 10 times the inference speed. The model returns a ranked set of supporting documents to a downstream answering model, cleanly separating search from generation. It decomposes high-level queries into sub-queries and iteratively searches a corpus across multiple turns, selectively discarding irrelevant results to free capacity as its context window fills.

Chroma Context-1 是一个拥有 200 亿参数的 智能体搜索（agentic search）模型，在八千多个合成生成的任务上进行了训练。它以极低的成本实现了与前沿模型相当的检索性能，且推理速度提升高达 10 倍。该模型向下游回答模型返回一组经过排序的支持文档，将搜索与生成清晰分离。它将高级查询分解为子查询，并在多轮对话中迭代搜索语料库，随着上下文窗口填满，有选择地丢弃不相关结果以释放容量。

Mistral Launches Voxtral TTS Model (6 minute read)

Mistral's Voxtral TTS is a 4B-parameter multilingual text-to-speech model designed for low-latency, expressive voice generation, and scalable deployment in voice agents.

Mistral 的 Voxtral TTS 是一个拥有 40 亿参数的多语言 文本转语音（TTS）模型，专为低延迟、富有表现力的语音生成以及在语音智能体中的可扩展部署而设计。

Anthropic wins preliminary injunction in DOD fight as judge cites 'First Amendment retaliation' (5 minute read)

Anthropic has won a preliminary injunction in its lawsuit against the Department of War over the ruling of the company as a 'supply chain risk'. The judge in the case said that nothing in the governing statute supports the notion that an American company can be branded a potential adversary and saboteur of the US for expressing disagreement with the government. Anthropic refused to grant the Pentagon unfettered access to its models across all lawful purposes, as it didn't want its technology to be used for fully autonomous weapons or domestic mass surveillance. The company says that it will continue working productively with the government.

Anthropic 在针对国防部（Department of War，原文如此）的诉讼中赢得了 初步禁令（preliminary injunction），该诉讼涉及该公司被列为"供应链风险（supply chain risk）"的裁定。本案法官表示，现行法规中没有任何内容支持这样的观念：一家美国公司可以因表达与政府的分歧而被贴上潜在对手和美国破坏者的标签。Anthropic 拒绝授予五角大楼（Pentagon）对其模型在所有合法用途上的无限制访问权，因为它不希望其技术被用于完全自主武器或国内大规模监控。该公司表示将继续与政府保持建设性合作。

What do frontier AI companies' job postings reveal about their plans? (10 minute read)

While AI companies guard their strategies closely, their hiring pages are public. These posts contain clues about what products companies are developing, who they hope to sell them to, and what bottlenecks they see coming. This post analyzes the current open roles at the leading foundation labs. As these labs continue to grow and their strategies change, their career pages will remain one of the best places to watch it happen.

虽然 AI 公司对其战略严格保密，但它们的招聘页面是公开的。这些招聘信息包含关于公司正在开发什么产品、希望卖给谁以及预见到的瓶颈是什么的线索。本文分析了领先的 基础模型实验室（foundation labs）当前的开放职位。随着这些实验室持续发展及其战略变化，它们的招聘页面仍将是观察这些变化的最佳窗口之一。

item.description:
标签: #CLI工具 #AI智能体 #开发工具

摘要: 本文报道了AI基础设施领域CLI（命令行界面）工具的集中爆发：从Stripe推出可自动配置第三方服务的Projects.dev，到Ramp、ElevenLabs、Google Workspace等厂商密集上线CLI产品，命令行界面正取代传统API成为AI Agent直接调用和配置后端服务的首选接口，标志着"Agent原生"基础设施范式的全面兴起。

原标题: [AINews] Everything is CLI

On its own, the launch of Projects.dev, a way for agents to instantly provision services, is not immediately title-story worthy except for 2 things: 1) it comes from STRIPE, 2) it is a CLI. Run stripe projects add posthog/analytics and it'll create a PostHog account, get an API key, and set up billing.

就其本身而言，Projects.dev（一种让智能体即时配置服务的方式）的发布并不立即值得作为头条新闻，除了两点：1）它来自 STRIPE（支付平台），2）它是一个 CLI（命令行界面，Command Line Interface）。运行 stripe projects add posthog/analytics，它就会创建一个 PostHog 账户，获取 API 密钥，并设置账单。

If that sounds weird to you, it's because Stripe doesn't really have anything to do with PostHog's setup or signup process. Neither do these launch partners:

如果这听起来很奇怪，那是因为 Stripe（支付平台）与 PostHog（产品分析平台）的设置或注册流程并无实质关联。以下这些发布合作伙伴（launch partners）也是如此：

Stripe is just doing this because they can, and Patrick cites Andrej's MenuGen as direct inspiration for how it is too hard for agents to set up backend services today. You're sure to see the rest of the agent-native infra vendor landscape charts all lobby Stripe for real estate:

Stripe 这么做纯粹是因为他们有能力这么做，Patrick（Stripe 创始人）援引 Andrej（Andrej Karpathy）的 MenuGen 作为直接灵感，说明如今智能体设置后端服务的过程过于困难。你肯定会看到智能体原生（agent-native）基础设施供应商领域的其他厂商都在争取 Stripe 的平台资源：

But let's not stop there: scroll down the timeline a little further and here's Ramp's CLI also launching today, with some handy usecases:

但我们不止步于此：将时间线往下滚动一点，Ramp（企业卡及费用管理平台）的 CLI 也在今天发布，带有一些实用的用例：

Oh and look over here! It's the Sendblue CLI (iMessage) you've always wanted, also launching today! catching up from the Kapso CLI (WhatsApp) from Monday! and did you miss the ElevenLabs CLI from yesterday? That's fine, because you could also try the Visa CLI, the Resend CLI, or the steipete's Discord CLI, the big momma, the official Google Workspace CLI!

哦，看这里！Sendblue CLI（iMessage 消息服务）——你一直想要的那个——也在今天发布！紧随其后的是周一发布的 Kapso CLI（WhatsApp）！还有，你错过了昨天的 ElevenLabs CLI 吗？没关系，因为你还可以试试 Visa CLI（支付网络）、Resend CLI（邮件发送服务），或者 steipete 的 Discord CLI，以及重磅级的官方 Google Workspace CLI！

Many, many people have written about why CLIs can be handier than MCPs, which isn't necessarily a fair nor false comparison, but at this point the trend is undeniable and worth reporting. We credit Cloudflare's Code Mode from last September in kicking off the "use more computer to wrap MCP" trend, and now of course CLIs in themselves don't really expose or care about their underlying communication protocols.

许多人写过为什么 CLI（命令行界面）比 MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）更方便，这不一定是个公平或错误的比较，但此时此刻，这一趋势已不可否认且值得报道。我们认为去年 9 月 Cloudflare 的 Code Mode 开启了"用更多计算资源来封装 MCP"的趋势，而现在 CLI 本身其实并不暴露或关心其底层的通信协议。

AI 新闻（2026年3月23日-24日）。我们检查了 12 个 subreddit、544 个 Twitter 账号，没有进一步的 Discord。AINews 的网站允许你搜索所有过往期数。提醒一下，AINews 现在是 Latent Space（播客/媒体平台）的一个栏目。你可以选择订阅/退订邮件频率！

AI Twitter Recap

Model and Product Releases: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, Mistral Voxtral TTS, Cohere Transcribe, and OpenAI GPT-5.4 mini/nano

  • Google's realtime push with Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Google rolled out Gemini 3.1 Flash Live as its new realtime model for voice and vision agents, emphasizing lower latency, improved function calling, better noisy-environment robustness, and 2x longer conversation memory in Gemini Live. The launch spans Gemini Live, Search Live, AI Studio preview, and enterprise CX surfaces, with Google citing 70 languages, 128k context, and watermarking of generated audio via SynthID in some developer-facing summaries (Logan Kilpatrick, Google DeepMind, Sundar Pichai, Google). Third-party benchmarking from Artificial Analysis highlights the new "thinking level" tradeoff: 95.9% Big Bench Audio at high reasoning with 2.98s TTFA, versus 70.5% at minimal with 0.96s TTFA.

  • Google（谷歌）推出 Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 进军实时推理：谷歌发布了 Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 作为其面向语音和视觉智能体（voice and vision agents）的新型实时模型，强调更低延迟、改进的函数调用能力、更好的嘈杂环境鲁棒性，以及在 Gemini Live 中2 倍长的对话记忆。该发布涵盖 Gemini Live、Search Live、AI Studio 预览版及企业 CX 界面，谷歌提到支持 70 种语言、128k 上下文，并通过 SynthID 对生成音频进行水印标记（Logan Kilpatrick、Google DeepMind、Sundar Pichai、Google）。第三方基准测试机构 Artificial Analysis 突出了新的"思考级别"权衡：高（high）推理模式下 Big Bench Audio 得分 95.9%，首 token 时间（TTFA）为 2.98 秒；而最小（minimal）模式下为 70.5%，TTFA 为 0.96 秒。

  • Speech stack gets crowded fast: Mistral AI released Voxtral TTS, an open-weight TTS model aimed at production voice agents, with 9-language support, low latency, and strong human preference metrics; several summaries cite a 3B/4B-class model footprint, ~90 ms time-to-first-audio, and favorable comparisons to ElevenLabs in preference tests (Mistral AI, Guillaume Lample, vLLM, kimmonismus). Cohere launched Cohere Transcribe, its first audio model, under Apache 2.0, claiming the top English spot on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboard with 5.42 WER and 14-language support (Cohere, Aidan Gomez, Jay Alammar). Notably, Cohere also contributed encoder-decoder serving optimizations to vLLM—variable-length encoder batching and packed decoder attention—reportedly yielding up to 2x throughput gains for speech workloads (vLLM).

  • 语音技术栈迅速拥挤：Mistral AI 发布了 Voxtral TTS（文本转语音），一个面向生产级语音智能体的开源权重 TTS 模型，支持 9 种语言，低延迟，且人类偏好指标强劲；多篇总结提到其模型规模为 3B/4B 级别（30-40 亿参数），首音频时间约 90 毫秒，在偏好测试中相比 ElevenLabs 表现更优（Mistral AI、Guillaume Lample、vLLM、kimmonismus）。Cohere 推出了其首个音频模型 Cohere Transcribe，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，声称在 Hugging Face Open ASR 排行榜上英语性能第一，词错误率（WER）为 5.42，支持 14 种语言（Cohere、Aidan Gomez、Jay Alammar）。值得注意的是，Cohere 还向 vLLM 贡献了编码器-解码器服务优化——可变长度编码器批处理和打包解码器注意力—— reportedly 为语音工作负载带来高达 2 倍吞吐量提升（vLLM）。

  • OpenAI's smaller GPT-5.4 variants look cost-competitive, with caveats: Artificial Analysis reported on GPT-5.4 mini and GPT-5.4 nano, both multimodal with 400k context and the same reasoning modes as GPT-5.4. The standout is GPT-5.4 nano, which was benchmarked ahead of Claude Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview on several agentic and terminal-style tasks while remaining cheaper on an effective-cost basis. The downside: both variants were described as highly verbose, with elevated output-token usage and weak AA-Omniscience performance driven by high hallucination rates. That matches anecdotal complaints from developers about codex/GPT-5.4 verbosity in practice (giffmana).

  • OpenAI 的小型 GPT-5.4 变体看起来具有成本竞争力，但附带条件：Artificial Analysis 报道了 GPT-5.4 mini 和 GPT-5.4 nano，两者均为多模态模型，支持 400k 上下文，并具有与 GPT-5.4 相同的推理模式。 standout 是 GPT-5.4 nano，在多个智能体和终端式任务上的基准测试超过了 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview，同时在有效成本基础上更便宜。缺点是：两个变体都被描述为高度冗长（highly verbose），输出 token 使用量高，且由于高幻觉率导致 AA-Omniscience 性能较弱。这与开发者关于 codex/GPT-5.4 在实践中过于冗长的传闻抱怨相符（giffmana）。

  • Other notable releases: Zai made GLM-5-Turbo available to GLM Coding Plan users; Reka put Reka Edge and Flash 3 on OpenRouter; Google/Gemini also began rolling out chat-history and preference import from other AI apps; and multiple posts reported that OpenAI has deprioritized side projects including Sora and an "adult mode" chatbot in favor of core productivity efforts (Andrew Curran, kimmonismus).

  • 其他值得注意的发布：Zai（智谱）向 GLM Coding Plan 用户开放 GLM-5-Turbo；Reka 将 Reka Edge 和 Flash 3 上线 OpenRouter；Google/Gemini 也开始推出从其他 AI 应用导入聊天记录和偏好设置的功能；多篇帖子报道称 OpenAI 已降低包括 Sora（视频生成模型）和"成人模式"聊天机器人在内的支线项目的优先级，以专注于核心生产力工作（Andrew Curran、kimmonismus）。

Agent Infrastructure, Harnesses, and Multi-Agent UX

  • Cline Kanban crystallizes a new multi-agent UX: The clearest tooling launch of the day was Cline Kanban, a free, open-source local web app for orchestrating multiple CLI coding agents in parallel across isolated git worktrees. It supports Claude Code, Codex, and Cline, lets users chain task dependencies, review diffs, and manage branches from one board (Cline, Cline). The reaction from builders was strong, with several calling this the likely default multi-agent interface because it tackles the two practical bottlenecks of current coding-agent workflows: inference-bound waiting and merge-conflict-heavy parallelism (Arafat, testingcatalog, sdrzn).

  • Cline Kanban 固化了新的多智能体用户体验：当天最清晰的工具发布是 Cline Kanban，一个免费、开源的本地 Web 应用，用于在隔离的 git worktrees（工作树）中并行编排多个 CLI 编码智能体。它支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cline，允许用户链式连接任务依赖、审查差异（diffs）并从一个面板管理分支（Cline、Cline）。构建者的反响强烈，多人称这可能成为默认的多智能体界面，因为它解决了当前编码智能体工作流的两个实际瓶颈：推理受限的等待（inference-bound waiting）和重度合并冲突的并行（merge-conflict-heavy parallelism）（Arafat、testingcatalog、sdrzn）。

  • "Harness engineering" is becoming a category: A recurring theme across tweets was that model quality is no longer the whole story; the agent harness—middleware, memory, task orchestration, tool interfaces, safety policies, and evaluation loops—is increasingly the real product. LangChain, hwchase17, and others emphasized middleware as the customization layer for agent behavior. voooooogel made the stronger claim that users casually say "LLM" when what they're actually using is an integrated agentic language system with formatting, parsers, tool use, structured generation, and memory around the base model.

  • "Harness engineering"（ harness 工程）正在成为一个类别：推文中反复出现的主题是模型质量不再是全部；agent harness（智能体 harness/ harness 架构）——包括中间件、记忆、任务编排、工具接口、安全策略和评估循环——越来越成为真正的产品。LangChain、hwchase17 等人强调 middleware（中间件）是自定义智能体行为的层。voooooogel 提出了更强的观点：用户随口说"LLM"（大语言模型）时，他们实际使用的是围绕基础模型集成的agentic language system（智能体语言系统），包含格式化、解析器、工具使用、结构化生成和记忆。

  • Hermes vs. OpenClaw: memory and long-running autonomy matter: A large cluster of posts praised Nous Research's Hermes Agent as more usable than OpenClaw/OpenClaw-derived stacks for long-running, cross-platform agent workflows. Examples included persistent memory across Slack and Telegram, shared memory across agents, lower maintenance overhead, and user reports of agents running unattended for hours on local or cloud setups (IcarusHermes, jayweeldreyer, Niels Rogge). Teknium also teased a controversial GODMODE skill for persistent jailbreaking, underscoring that capability and safety are now being productized at the harness layer, not just the base model.

  • Hermes 对比 OpenClaw：记忆和长期自主能力至关重要：大量帖子称赞 Nous Research 的 Hermes Agent 在长期运行的跨平台智能体工作流中比 OpenClaw/OpenClaw 衍生栈更易用。例子包括跨 Slack 和 Telegram 的持久记忆（persistent memory）、跨智能体的共享记忆、更低的维护开销，以及用户报告称智能体可在本地或云端设置中无人值守运行数小时（IcarusHermes、jayweeldreyer、Niels Rogge）。Teknium 还预告了一个有争议的 GODMODE skill 用于持久越狱（jailbreaking），强调能力和安全性现在正在 harness 层被产品化，而不仅仅是在基础模型层。

  • Tooling expansion around agents: OpenAI's Codex team solicited requests for expanded toolkit integrations (reach_vb), while Google published how it built a Gemini API skill to teach models about newer APIs and SDKs, improving Gemini 3.1 Proto 95% pass rate on 117 eval tests (Phil Schmid). OpenEnv was introduced as an open standard for agentic RL environments with async APIs, websocket transport, MCP-native tool discovery, and deploy-anywhere packaging.

  • 智能体周边工具扩展：OpenAI 的 Codex 团队征求扩展工具包集成的请求（reach_vb），同时 Google 发布了如何构建 Gemini API skill 来教授模型关于新 API 和 SDK 的知识，使 Gemini 3.1 Proto 在 117 项评估测试中的通过率达到 95%（Phil Schmid）。OpenEnv 被引入作为 agentic RL environments（智能体强化学习环境）的开放标准，具备异步 API、websocket 传输、MCP 原生工具发现和随处部署打包能力。

Research Systems and Training Infrastructure: AI Scientist, ProRL Agent, and Real-Time RL

  • Sakana AI's AI Scientist gets a Nature milestone and a scaling-law claim: The most substantive research-system update came from Sakana AI, which highlighted a Nature paper on end-to-end automation of AI research and a notable empirical result: using an automated reviewer to grade generated papers, they observed a scaling law for AI science, where stronger foundation models produce stronger scientific papers, and argued that this should improve both with better base models and more inference-time compute (Sakana AI, paper/code follow-up). Chris Lu added that AI Scientist V1 predated o1-preview-style reasoning models, implying substantial headroom from today's stronger models (Chris Lu).

  • Sakana AI 的 AI Scientist 获得 Nature 里程碑及 scaling law 宣称：最实质性的研究系统更新来自 Sakana AI，该团队强调了一篇关于 AI 研究端到端自动化的 Nature 论文，以及一个显著的实证结果：使用自动化审稿人评分生成论文，他们观察到了 scaling law for AI science（AI 科学的扩展定律），即更强的基础模型产生更强的科学论文，并认为这应随着更好的基础模型和更多 inference-time compute（推理时计算）而改善（Sakana AI，论文/代码后续）。Chris Lu 补充说 AI Scientist V1 早于 o1-preview 风格的推理模型，意味着当今更强的模型还有巨大的提升空间（Chris Lu）。

  • Infrastructure bottlenecks, not model bottlenecks, may be capping agent RL: One of the more important systems threads argued that agentic RL frameworks have been architected incorrectly by coupling rollout and optimization in the same process. The post summarizing NVIDIA's ProRL Agent claims fully decoupling rollout into a standalone service nearly doubled Qwen 8B on SWE-Bench Verified from 9.6% to 18.0%, with similar gains for 4B and 14B variants, alongside much higher GPU utilization (rryssf_). If accurate, this is a strong reminder that agent training benchmarks can be infra-limited, not purely capability-limited.

  • 基础设施瓶颈而非模型瓶颈可能正在限制智能体 RL（强化学习）：一条更重要的系统线程认为，智能体 RL 框架的架构设计有误，将 rollout（ rollout ）和优化耦合在同一进程中。总结 NVIDIA ProRL Agent 的帖子声称，将 rollout 完全解耦为独立服务几乎使 Qwen 8B（通义千问 8B）在 SWE-Bench Verified 上的得分从 9.6% 翻倍至 18.0%，4B 和 14B 变体也有类似提升，同时 GPU 利用率大幅提高（rryssf_）。如果准确，这强烈提醒我们智能体训练基准可能受限于基础设施（infra-limited），而非纯粹的能力受限。

  • Cursor's "real-time RL" is a notable production-training pattern: Cursor said it can ship improved Composer 2 checkpoints every five hours, presenting this as a productized RL feedback loop rather than a static model-release cadence. Multiple engineers read this as an early sign of continual learning in production, especially for vertically integrated apps with high-frequency interaction data (eliebakouch, code_star).

  • Cursor 的"real-time RL"（实时强化学习）是一个值得注意的生产级训练模式：Cursor 称它可以每 五小时发布改进的 Composer 2 检查点，将其呈现为产品化的 RL 反馈循环，而非静态的模型发布节奏。多位工程师将此解读为 生产环境持续学习（continual learning in production）的早期迹象，特别是对于拥有高频交互数据的垂直整合应用（eliebakouch、code_star）。

Architecture, Retrieval, and Inference Efficiency

  • Transformer depth is becoming "queryable": Kimi/Moonshot described Attention Residuals (AttnRes) as turning depth into an attention problem, allowing layers to retrieve selectively from prior layer outputs rather than passively accumulating residuals (Kimi). A strong secondary explainer from The Turing Post framed this as a broader trend: deep transformers moving from fixed residual addition toward adaptive retrieval over depth.

  • Transformer 深度正变得"可查询"：Kimi/Moonshot（月之暗面）将 Attention Residuals (AttnRes)（注意力残差）描述为将深度转化为注意力问题，允许层从先前层的输出中选择性检索，而非被动累积残差（Kimi）。来自 The Turing Post 的强有力二次解读将此框定为更广泛的趋势：深度 transformer 正从固定残差添加转向跨深度自适应检索（adaptive retrieval over depth）。

  • Compression and memory-efficiency work remains central: TurboQuant drew attention as a practical route to 3-bit-like compression with near-zero accuracy loss, combining PolarQuant and 1-bit error correction (QJL) to accelerate attention and vector search, reduce KV cache memory, and avoid retraining (The Turing Post). Separately, a subtle but impactful production bugfix landed in vLLM's Mamba-1 CUDA kernel after AI21 tracked a silent uint32_t overflow that caused logprob mismatches in GRPO training; the fix was effectively changing uint32_t to size_t (vLLM, AI21).

  • 压缩和内存效率工作仍居核心地位：TurboQuant 作为实现近零精度损失的 3-bit-like compression（类 3 位压缩）的实用路径引起关注，结合 PolarQuant 和 1-bit error correction (QJL)（1 位误差校正）来加速注意力和向量搜索，减少 KV 缓存内存，并避免重新训练（The Turing Post）。另据报道，AI21 追踪到一个静默的 uint32_t 溢出问题导致 GRPO 训练中的对数概率不匹配后，一个微妙但影响深远的生产级错误修复被合并到 vLLM 的 Mamba-1 CUDA kernel 中；修复实际上是将 uint32_t 改为 size_t（vLLM、AI21）。

  • Retrieval is trending multimodal and specialized: Several posts pointed to a shift away from generic RAG recipes. Victoria Slocum highlighted IRPAPERS, showing that OCR/text retrieval and image-page retrieval fail on different queries, and that multimodal fusion beats either alone on scientific PDFs. Chroma open-sourced Context-1, a search-focused model trained with SFT+RL over 8,000+ synthetic tasks, claiming better/faster/cheaper search than frontier general-purpose models; John Schulman called out its curriculum, verified synthetic data, and context-pruning tool as especially interesting.

  • 检索正趋向多模态和专业化：多篇帖子指出正从通用 RAG（检索增强生成）方案转向更专业的方案。Victoria Slocum 强调了 IRPAPERS，表明 OCR/text retrieval（OCR/文本检索）和 image-page retrieval（图像-页面检索）在不同查询上失效，而多模态融合在科学 PDF 上优于单独使用任一方法。Chroma 开源了 Context-1，一个面向搜索的模型，通过 SFT+RL（监督微调+强化学习）在 8,000+ 合成任务上训练，声称比前沿通用模型搜索得更好/更快/更便宜；John Schulman 指出其课程学习（curriculum）、经过验证的合成数据和上下文剪枝工具特别有趣。

Top tweets (by engagement)

  • Meta's TRIBE v2: Meta released TRIBE v2, a trimodal brain encoder trained on 500+ hours of fMRI from 700+ people, claiming 2–3x improvement over prior methods and zero-shot prediction for unseen subjects, languages, and tasks (Meta AI, details).

  • Meta 的 TRIBE v2：Meta 发布了 TRIBE v2，一个在三模态（trimodal）脑编码器，基于 700 多人的 500+ 小时 fMRI（功能性磁共振成像）数据训练，声称比之前方法提升 2-3 倍，并对未见过的受试者、语言和任务具备零样本预测能力（Meta AI，详情）。

  • Claude Code auto-fix in the cloud: Anthropic shipped remote PR-following auto-fix for Claude Code web/mobile sessions, allowing unattended CI-failure fixing and comment resolution (Noah Zweben).

    li>Claude Code 云端自动修复：Anthropic 为 Claude Code 网页/移动端会话推出了远程 PR-following auto-fix（跟随 PR 的自动修复），允许无人值守的 CI（持续集成）故障修复和评论解决（Noah Zweben）。

  • Karpathy on full-stack software automation: Andrej Karpathy argued the hard part of "build me this startup" is not code generation but the full DevOps/service orchestration lifecycle—payments, auth, infra, security, deployment—which he sees as just becoming tractable for agents.

  • Karpathy（Andrej Karpathy，前特斯拉 AI 总监、OpenAI 创始成员）谈全栈软件自动化：Andrej Karpathy 认为"帮我构建这个创业公司"的难点不在于代码生成，而在于完整的 DevOps/service orchestration lifecycle（DevOps/服务编排生命周期）——支付、认证、基础设施、安全、部署——他认为这些对智能体来说才刚刚变得可处理。

  • Cline Kanban: The launch of multi-agent worktree orchestration for coding agents generated unusually strong developer interest (Cline).

  • Cline Kanban：面向编码智能体的多智能体工作树（worktree）编排工具的发布引发了异常强烈的开发者兴趣（Cline）。

  • Cohere Transcribe and Mistral Voxtral: Open, production-oriented audio releases continue to gather momentum, especially where they come with permissive licensing and immediate infra support (Cohere, Mistral).

item.title: [翻译] Construction Physics: 放大器时代
item.description:
标签: #放大器 #贝尔实验室 #技术史

摘要: 文章回顾了20世纪AT&T贝尔实验室为实现电话"普遍服务"而攻克长距离信号放大难题的历程，详述了真空管、负反馈放大器、晶体管和激光器四项关键技术的诞生过程，以及这些最初为电话系统发明的技术如何超越通信领域，奠定现代电子学、控制论与数字时代的基石。

原标题: The Age of the Amplifier

As we've noted more than a few times before, for most of the 20th century AT&T's Bell Labs was the premier industrial research lab in the US. As part of its ongoing efforts to provide universal telephone service, Bell Labs generated numerous world-changing inventions, and accumulated more Nobel Prizes than any other industrial research lab.1 But the most important of its technical contributions proved to be useful far beyond the confines of the Bell System. Statistical process control, for instance, was invented by AT&T engineer Walter Shewhart to improve the manufacturing of AT&T's electrical equipment at supplier company Western Electric. Since then, the methods have been successfully applied to all manner of manufacturing, from jet engines to semiconductors to container ships.

正如我们此前多次提到的，在20世纪的大部分时间里，AT&T的贝尔实验室（Bell Labs）是美国首屈一指的工业研究实验室。作为其提供普遍电话服务持续努力的一部分，贝尔实验室产生了众多改变世界的发明，积累的诺贝尔奖数量超过任何其他工业研究实验室。但其最重要的技术贡献被证明远远超出了贝尔系统（Bell System）的范围。例如，统计过程控制（Statistical Process Control, SPC）就是由AT&T工程师沃尔特·休哈特（Walter Shewhart）发明的，目的是改进AT&T在供应商西部电气公司（Western Electric）的电气设备制造。此后，这些方法被成功应用于各种制造领域，从喷气发动机到半导体再到集装箱船舶。

Interestingly, some of AT&T's most important technological contributions — namely, the vacuum tube, the negative feedback amplifier, the transistor, and the laser — were (in whole or in part) the product of efforts to make new, better amplifiers for boosting electromagnetic signals. Amplifiers played a crucial role in the Bell System, making it possible to (among other things) connect telephones over long distances, but the value of these four amplifiers extended far beyond telephony. The vacuum tube became a crucial building block for electronics in the first half of the 20th century, used in everything from radio to television to the earliest computers. The negative feedback amplifier helped spawn the discipline of control theory, which is used today in the design of virtually every automated machine. The transistor is the foundation of modern digital computing and everything built on top of it. And the laser is used in everything from fiber-optic communications to industrial cutting machines to barcode scanners to printers.

有趣的是，AT&T一些最重要的技术贡献——即真空管（vacuum tube）、负反馈放大器（negative feedback amplifier）、晶体管（transistor）和激光器（laser）——（全部或部分）都是为了制造新型、更好的放大器（amplifier）以增强电磁信号而产生的成果。放大器在贝尔系统中发挥了关键作用，使得（其中包括）长途电话连接成为可能，但这四种放大器的价值远远超出了电话通信的范畴。真空管成为20世纪上半叶电子学的重要构建模块，被用于从收音机、电视到最早期的计算机等各种设备。负反馈放大器促进了控制理论（control theory）学科的诞生，如今该理论被应用于几乎所有自动化机械的设计中。晶体管是现代数字计算及其上层所有技术的基础。而激光器则被应用于从光纤通信到工业切割机，再到条码扫描仪和打印机等各个领域。

It's worth looking at why AT&T was so motivated to build better and better amplifiers, and why those efforts produced so many transformative inventions.

值得探究的是，为何AT&T如此执着于制造越来越好的放大器，以及这些努力为何催生了如此多变革性的发明。

The vacuum tube

真空管

In 1876 Alexander Graham Bell placed the world's first telephone call, summoning his assistant Thomas Watson from another room. By 1881, Bell's company, the Bell Telephone Company (it wouldn't become American Telephone and Telegraph, or AT&T, until 1899) had 100,000 customers. By the turn of the century AT&T was operating 1,300 telephone exchanges in the US, connecting over 800,000 customers with 2 million miles of wire.

1876年，亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔（Alexander Graham Bell）拨通了世界上第一通电话，将他的助手托马斯·沃森（Thomas Watson）从另一个房间召唤过来。到1881年，贝尔的公司——贝尔电话公司（Bell Telephone Company，直到1899年才更名为美国电话电报公司，即AT&T）已拥有10万客户。到世纪之交，AT&T在美国运营着1,300个电话交换局，连接着80多万客户，拥有200万英里的电线。

The goal of the Bell System was "universal service" – to connect every telephone user with every other telephone user in the system. But by the early 20th century this quest was bumping up against technological limitations.

贝尔系统的目标是"普遍服务"（universal service）——将系统中的每一位电话用户与其他所有用户连接起来。但到了20世纪初，这一追求开始遭遇技术限制。

Telephones converted the sound of someone speaking to electrical signals, which were transmitted along wires until reaching a telephone on the other end, where they were converted back into sound. More specifically, in early telephones the sound from someone speaking would compress and decompress a chamber full of carbon granules, which would alter their electrical resistance, changing how much current flowed through them. At the other end, the electrical current would flow through an electromagnet, which pulled on a thin iron diaphragm; fluctuations in the electrical current would change the motion of the diaphragm, reproducing the speech.

电话机将人声转换为电信号，沿电线传输至另一端的电话机，再转换回声音。更具体地说，在早期的电话机中，说话的声音会压缩和 decompress 一个充满碳粒的腔室，从而改变其电阻，进而改变流过它们的电流量。在另一端，电流流过一个电磁铁，电磁铁拉动一块薄铁膜片；电流的波动会改变膜片的运动，从而重现语音。

But the farther electrical signals travelled, the more they would be attenuated. Resistance from the wire carrying them would convert some of the electrical energy into heat, and electrical current could "leak" between adjacent telephone wires. As the electrical signals got weaker and weaker, the sound would be less and less intelligible when reproduced, until it couldn't be heard at all. If AT&T wanted to provide universal service, it would need a way to maintain the strength of the electrical signal as it traveled over long distances.

但电信号传输得越远，衰减（attenuation）就越严重。传输电线的电阻会将部分电能转化为热能，而且电流可能在相邻的电话线之间"泄漏"。随着电信号变得越来越弱，重现的声音就越来越难以辨识，直到完全听不见了。如果AT&T想要提供普遍服务，就需要一种在长途传输中保持电信号强度的方法。

AT&T was able to partly resolve this problem using the loading coil, an invention of electrical engineer Michael Pupin. (Lines which had loading coils added to them were sometimes described as being "Pupinized.") The loading coil added inductance (a tendency to resist changes in current) to telephone lines, which reduced signal attenuation. As a result, the loading coil roughly doubled the effective distance limit of telephone calls, from around 1000-1200 miles to closer to 2000 miles. But the loading coil merely reduced signal attenuation; the signal was still decaying as it traveled along the lines, just more slowly. Without some way of actually amplifying the telephone signals, the maximum distance for a telephone line was enough to connect New York to Denver, but not enough to reach the West Coast from New York and connect the entire country.

AT&T通过使用加载线圈（loading coil）部分解决了这一问题，这是电气工程师迈克尔·普平（Michael Pupin）的发明。（加装了加载线圈的线路有时被描述为"普平化"的。）加载线圈为电话线增加了电感（inductance，即抵抗电流变化的特性），从而减少了信号衰减。结果，加载线圈大致将电话通话的有效距离限制从约1,000-1,200英里翻倍至接近2,000英里。但加载线圈仅仅是减少了信号衰减；信号在沿线路传输时仍在衰减，只是速度更慢。如果没有实际放大（amplifying）电话信号的方法，电话线的最大距离足以连接纽约和丹佛，但不足以从纽约到达西海岸并连接整个国家。

AT&T experimented with various mechanical amplifiers, which converted the electrical signals into mechanical movements and then back to electrical signals, but these were found to greatly distort the signal, and were not widely used. What was needed was an electronic amplifier, which could amplify the electrical signals directly, without the lossy and distorting effects of mechanical translation. In 1911, AT&T formed a special research branch to tackle the problem of long-distance transmission, and hired the young physicist Harold Arnold (who would later become the first director of research at Bell Labs) to research possible amplifiers based on the "new physics" of electrons.

AT&T尝试了各种机械放大器（mechanical amplifiers），它们将电信号转换为机械运动再转换回电信号，但发现这些装置会严重失真，因此未被广泛使用。需要的是一种电子放大器（electronic amplifier），它能直接放大电信号，而无需经过机械转换带来的损耗和失真。1911年，AT&T成立了一个专门的研究部门来解决长途传输问题，并聘请了年轻的物理学家哈罗德·阿诺德（Harold Arnold，他后来成为贝尔实验室的第一任研究主任），基于电子的"新物理学"研究可能的放大器。

At first, Arnold had little success. He looked at a variety of possible amplifying technologies, and experimented extensively with mercury discharge tubes (which initially seemed promising), but nothing appeared to fit AT&T's requirements. But in 1912, Arnold learned of a new, promising amplifier known as the audion, which had been brought to AT&T by American inventor Lee de Forest. De Forest's audion was, in turn, based on an invention of the British physicist Ambrose Fleming, known as the "Fleming valve." Fleming was inspired by extensive experimentation with what was known as the "Edison Effect:" the observation that in an incandescent bulb, electric current would flow from the heated filament to a nearby metal plate. Fleming used this effect to create a diode, a device which lets electric current flow in one direction but not another. De Forest modified Fleming's valve by adding a third element, a metallic grid, between the filament and the plate. By varying the voltage at the metallic grid, De Forest eventually discovered he could control the flow of electrical current from the filament to the plate. This allowed the device to act as an amplifier: a small change in the voltage could create a much larger change in the current flowing from the filament to the plate.

起初，阿诺德并未取得多大成功。他研究了各种可能的放大技术，并广泛试验了汞放电管（起初看起来很有希望），但似乎没有一样符合AT&T的要求。但在1912年，阿诺德听说了一种新的、有前景的放大器，称为三极检波管（audion），这是由美国发明家李·德富雷斯特（Lee de Forest）带到AT&T的。德富雷斯特的三极检波管又是基于英国物理学家安布罗斯·弗莱明（Ambrose Fleming）的发明，即"弗莱明阀"（Fleming valve）。弗莱明受到对所谓"爱迪生效应"（Edison Effect）广泛实验的启发：观察发现，在白炽灯泡中，电流会从加热的灯丝流向附近的金属板。弗莱明利用这一效应制造了二极管（diode），一种只允许电流单向流动的装置。德富雷斯特在弗莱明阀的基础上增加了第三个元件——一个金属栅极，位于灯丝和金属板之间。通过改变金属栅极的电压，德富雷斯特最终发现他可以控制从灯丝流向金属板的电流。这使得该装置能够充当放大器：电压的微小变化可以产生从灯丝流向金属板的电流的大幅变化。

De Forest's audion had uneven performance — notably, it couldn't handle the level of energy needed for a telephone line. Moreover, it was clear that De Forest did not quite understand how the device worked. But Arnold, well-versed in the physics of electrons, recognized its potential, and realized that, with modifications, its various limitations could be overcome. Via "The Continuous Wave," a history of early radio:

德富雷斯特的三极检波管性能不稳定—— notably，它无法处理电话线所需的能量水平。而且，很明显德富雷斯特并不太理解该装置的工作原理。但精通电子物理学的阿诺德认识到了它的潜力，并意识到通过改进，可以克服其各种局限性。引自《连续波》（The Continuous Wave），一部关于早期无线电历史的著作：

Arnold knew exactly what to do about the audion's limitations. "I suggested that we make the thing larger, increase the size of the plate with the corresponding increases in the size of the grid but particularly at that time I suggested that we were not getting enough electrons from the filament." What he wanted to do, in fact, was convert the de Forest audion into a different kind of device. He wanted a much higher vacuum in the tube, with residual gas eliminated to the greatest possible extent; and he knew the newly invented Gaede molecular vacuum pump made that possible. He wanted more electron emission from the filament without an increase in filament voltage; and he knew Wehnelt's new oxide-coated filaments would do that.
阿诺德完全知道该如何解决三极检波管的局限性。"我建议我们把这个东西做得更大，增大金属板的尺寸，并相应地增大栅极的尺寸，但特别是当时我认为我们从灯丝获得的电子不够多。"事实上，他想做的是将德富雷斯特的三极检波管转换成一种不同的装置。他想要管内有更高的真空度，尽可能消除残余气体；他知道新发明的盖德分子真空泵（Gaede molecular vacuum pump）使这成为可能。他想要灯丝在不增加电压的情况下发射更多电子；他知道韦内尔特（Wehnelt）的新型氧化物涂层灯丝可以做到这一点。
After paying $50,000 (roughly $1.6 million in 2026 dollars) for the rights to the audion, Arnold and others at AT&T spent the next year turning it into a practical electronic amplifier: the triode vacuum tube. By June 1914, vacuum tube amplifiers were being installed on a transcontinental telephone line connecting New York and San Francisco, and in January of 1915 the transcontinental line was inaugurated at the Panama-Pacific International Exposition with a call between Alexander Graham Bell in New York and Thomas Watson in San Francisco. By the late 1920s, AT&T was using over 100,000 vacuum tubes in its telephone system, and triodes and their descendents (four-element tetrodes, five-element pentodes) would go on to be used in all manner of electronic devices, from radios to TVs to the first digital computers.

在支付了5万美元（约合2026年的160万美元）购买三极检波管的专利使用权后，阿诺德和AT&T的其他人花了接下来一年时间将其改造成实用的电子放大器：三极真空管（triode vacuum tube）。到1914年6月，真空管放大器被安装在连接纽约和旧金山的横贯大陆电话线上，1915年1月，这条横贯大陆的线路在巴拿马-太平洋国际博览会上正式启用，亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔在纽约与托马斯·沃森在旧金山之间进行了通话。到20世纪20年代末，AT&T在其电话系统中使用了超过10万只真空管，而三极管及其后代（四极四极管、五极五极管）随后被用于各种电子设备，从收音机、电视到最早的数字计算机。

The vacuum tube, with its ability to amplify electronic signals, represented a sea change in how AT&T engineers thought about telephone service. Prior to the electronic amplifier, a telephone call was essentially a single diminishing stream of electromagnetic energy. The range of that energy could be extended farther and farther from the speaker at the steep cost of its fidelity. The amplifier made it possible to consider a telephone call as a stream of information, as a signal that was distinct from the medium that carried it. It could be ably renewed, translated, modified in new and exciting ways. As historian David Mindell notes:

真空管具有放大电子信号的能力，这代表了AT&T工程师对电话服务看法的根本转变。在电子放大器出现之前，电话通话本质上是一股不断减弱的电磁能量流。这种能量的传输范围可以离说话者越来越远，但要以牺牲保真度为代价。放大器使得人们可以将电话通话视为一股信息（information）流，一种与其传输介质截然不同的信号。它可以被有效地更新、转换、以新的令人兴奋的方式修改。正如历史学家大卫·明德（David Mindell）所指出的：

…a working amplifier could renew the signal at any point, and hence maintain it through complicated manipulations, making possible long strings of filters, modulators, and transmission lines. Electricity in the wires became merely a carrier of messages, not a source of power, and hence opened the door to new ways of thinking about communications…The message was no longer the medium, now it was a signal that could be understood and manipulated on its own terms, independent of its physical embodiment.
……一个可用的放大器可以在任何一点更新信号，因此可以通过复杂的操作维持信号，使得长串的滤波器、调制器和传输线成为可能。电线中的电仅仅成为信息的载体，而不是动力源，从而为通信的新思维方式打开了大门……信息不再是媒介，现在它是一种可以按其自身条件被理解和操作的信号，独立于其物理载体。

The negative feedback amplifier

负反馈放大器

Thanks to vacuum tube amplifiers, AT&T could finally fulfill its dream of universal telephone service, connecting telephones to each other anywhere in the continental US. But vacuum tubes were far from perfect amplifiers. The ideal amplifier has a linear relationship between the input and the output, effectively multiplying the input current or voltage by some value. If this relationship is non-linear, some inputs will be multiplied more than others, and the signal will become distorted. This distortion can garble speech, and — on a wire carrying multiple telephone calls — can create cross-talk, with speech from one telephone call being heard on another.

多亏了真空管放大器，AT&T终于能够实现其普遍电话服务的梦想，将美国大陆任何地点的电话相互连接。但真空管远非完美的放大器。理想的放大器在输入和输出之间具有线性（linear）关系，有效地将输入电流或电压乘以某个数值。如果这种关系是非线性的，某些输入会被放大得比其他输入更多，信号就会产生失真。这种失真会混淆语音，而且在承载多路电话通话的线路上，会产生串音（cross-talk），即一路通话的语音被另一路听到。

The vacuum tube was a superior amplifier to anything that preceded it, but it wasn't a perfectly linear amplifier; its amplification curve formed more of an S-shape, under-amplifying low values and over-amplifying high ones. For a line carrying a single telephone call, the resulting distortion could be mitigated by restricting inputs to the linear portion of the curve, but as AT&T adopted carrier modulation — carrying multiple calls at different frequencies on a single line — distortion became more of a problem.

真空管比之前的任何放大器都更优越，但它并非完美的线性放大器；其放大曲线呈S形，对低值欠放大，对高值过放大。对于承载单路电话通话的线路，可以通过将输入限制在曲线的线性部分来缓解由此产生的失真，但随着AT&T采用载波调制（carrier modulation）——在一条线路上以不同频率承载多路通话——失真 became more of a problem。

In 1921, Harold Black, a 23 year old electrical engineer, joined AT&T. He soon produced a report analyzing the future potential of a transcontinental telephone line carrying thousands of carrier-modulated conversations. At the time, carrier modulation was being used to carry at most three calls on a single line. Black's analysis showed that such a line would require an amplifier with far less distortion than existing vacuum tubes, and Black began to work on developing an improved amplifier as a side project.

1921年，23岁的电气工程师哈罗德·布莱克（Harold Black）加入了AT&T。他很快撰写了一份报告，分析承载数千路载波调制通话的横贯大陆电话线的未来潜力。当时，载波调制最多只能在一条线路上承载三路通话。布莱克的分析表明，这样的线路需要一种比现有真空管失真小得多的放大器，于是布莱克开始着手开发一种改进型放大器作为副业项目。

At first, Black simply tried to create vacuum tubes with less distortion, a project that many others at AT&T were also working on. The efforts of Black and others produced higher-quality vacuum tubes, but nothing Black tried reduced the distortion to the degree he was aiming for.

起初，布莱克只是试图制造失真更小的真空管，这是AT&T许多其他人也在进行的项目。布莱克和其他人的努力生产出了更高质量的真空管，但布莱克尝试的任何东西都未能将失真降低到他所追求的程度。

After two years of failure, Black decided to pivot; rather than trying again and again to build a perfectly linear amplifier, he would accept that any amplifier he made might be imperfect, and instead find a way to remove the distortion that it introduced.

经过两年的失败，布莱克决定转变思路；与其一次又一次地试图制造完美的线性放大器，他不如接受他制造的任何放大器都可能是不完美的，转而寻找一种消除其引入的失真的方法。

Black first tried to do this by subtracting the input signal from the amplifier's output, leaving behind just the distortion, and then amplifying that distortion and subtracting that from the output signal. This method — the "feedforward amplifier" — worked, but not well. It required having two amplifiers (one for the original signal, and one for the distortion) that needed to have very precisely matched amplification characteristics, and maintaining that alignment over a wide range of frequencies and for a long period of time proved difficult. As Black noted later:

布莱克首先尝试通过从放大器输出中减去输入信号来做到这一点，这样就只剩下失真，然后放大该失真并将其从输出信号中减去。这种方法——"前馈放大器"（feedforward amplifier）——有效，但效果不佳。它需要两个放大器（一个用于原始信号，一个用于失真），这两个放大器需要具有非常精确匹配的放大特性，而在宽频率范围内和长时间内保持这种对齐证明是困难的。正如布莱克后来指出的：

For example, every hour on the hour —24 hours a day —somebody had to adjust the filament current to its correct value. In doing this, they were permitting plus or minus 1/2-to-l dB variation in amplifier gain, whereas, for my purpose, the gain had to be absolutely perfect. In addition, every six hours it became necessary to adjust the B battery voltage, because the amplifier gain would be out of hand. There were other complications too, but these were enough! Nothing came of my efforts, however, because every circuit I devised turned out to be far too complex to be practical.
例如，每小时的整点——每天24小时——都必须有人将灯丝电流调整到正确值。这样做时，他们允许放大器增益有正负0.5到1分贝的变化，而对于我的目的来说，增益必须绝对完美。此外，每六小时就需要调整B电池电压，因为放大器增益会失控。还有其他复杂情况，但这些就足够了！然而，我的努力没有结果，因为我设计的每一个电路都证明过于复杂，不切实际。
Black grappled with the problem over the next several years, until suddenly realizing the solution while taking the ferry to work one morning in 1927. An electromagnetic signal consisted of a wave, alternating back and forth between positive and negative voltage. If you took a fraction of the output from an amplifier, and subtracted that from the input signal before it got amplified — by modifying the input with negative feedback — you would cancel out the distortion. Because this would reduce the strength of the input signal, this would have the downside of greatly reducing the how much the signal would be amplified (known as the gain), but that was ok; the distortion would be reduced so much that you could get as much gain as you needed by stringing several such amplifiers together. And unlike Black's feedforward amplifier, this negative feedback amplifier would be self-correcting: any unexpected change to the gain in the amplifier would become a change in the feedback signal, compensating for the change.

在接下来的几年里，布莱克一直与这个问题作斗争，直到1927年一个早晨乘渡轮上班时突然想到了解决方案。电磁信号由波组成，在正负电压之间来回交替。如果从放大器输出中取出一部分，并在信号被放大之前将其从输入信号中减去——通过负反馈（negative feedback）修改输入——你就可以消除失真。因为这会降低输入信号的强度，这会带来一个缺点，即大大减小信号被放大的程度（称为增益，gain），但这没关系；失真会被大大降低，以至于你可以通过将几个这样的放大器串联起来获得所需的任何增益。而且与布莱克的前馈放大器不同，这种负反馈放大器将是自我校正的：放大器中增益的任何意外变化都会成为反馈信号的变化，从而补偿该变化。

By the end of the year, Black had built a negative feedback amplifier that reduced distortion by a factor of 100,000. But Black had a difficult time convincing others of the merits of his invention. At the time feedback was largely considered undesirable by electrical engineers. Feedback could cause an amplifier to "sing" and start generating its own output, known as self-oscillation, overwhelming the input signal. (Think of the high-pitched sound that you get when placing a microphone next to a speaker.) Engineers went to significant efforts to prevent feedback-related problems.

到那年年底，布莱克已经制造出一种负反馈放大器，将失真降低了10万倍。但布莱克很难说服其他人相信他的发明的优点。当时，电气工程师普遍认为反馈是不受欢迎的。反馈可能导致放大器"啸叫"并开始产生自己的输出，称为自激振荡（self-oscillation），压倒输入信号。（想想将麦克风放在扬声器旁边时听到的高频啸叫声。）工程师们付出了巨大努力来防止与反馈相关的问题。

At the time it was also believed that an amplifier with high levels of feedback would be fundamentally unstable. Opposition to Black's amplifier was so severe that securing a US patent required "long drawn-out arguments with the patent office," and the British patent office treated the invention the way they treated perpetual motion machines, demanding a working model. Harold Arnold, who had since become director of research at Bell Labs, "refused to accept a negative feedback amplifier, and directed Black to design conventional amplifiers instead."

当时人们还认为，具有高反馈水平的放大器在根本上是不稳定的。对布莱克放大器的反对如此激烈，以至于获得美国专利需要"与专利局进行长时间的争论"，而英国专利局则像对待永动机一样对待这项发明，要求提供工作模型。已成为贝尔实验室研究主任的哈罗德·阿诺德（Harold Arnold）"拒绝接受负反馈放大器，并指示布莱克改而设计传统放大器"。

In practice, keeping the amplifier stable (avoiding self-oscillation) while also stringing together amplifiers in sequence proved to be a complex problem. These issues were resolved in part thanks to the help of two other Bell Labs researchers, Harry Nyquist and Henrik Bode. Nyquist and Bode studied the behavior of the negative feedback amplifier, and created mathematical tools for analyzing it and determining the conditions under which it would be stable.

在实践中，保持放大器稳定（避免自激振荡）同时将放大器串联起来证明是一个复杂的问题。这些问题部分归功于贝尔实验室另外两位研究员哈里·奈奎斯特（Harry Nyquist）和亨里克·波德（Henrik Bode）的帮助而得以解决。奈奎斯特和波德研究了负反馈放大器的行为，并创建了用于分析它并确定其在何种条件下稳定的数学工具。

Taken together, these efforts turned Black's invention into a mainstay of electronics. Within 25 years, thanks to the work of Black, Nyquist, Bode, and others, the principle of negative feedback was "applied almost universally to amplifiers used for any purpose," and it continues to be used in the design of modern amplifiers.

总而言之，这些努力使布莱克的发明成为电子学的主流。在25年内，由于布莱克、奈奎斯特、波德和其他人的工作，负反馈原理被"几乎普遍应用于用于任何目的的放大器"，并继续用于现代放大器的设计中。

The effects of the Bell Labs work on negative feedback resonated far beyond amplification. A parallel tradition of feedback-based devices existed in mechanical engineering, in the design of things like governors and servomechanisms. During WWII, these two traditions began to merge into the modern discipline of control theory, which studies how to control a dynamic system using feedback. Feedback loops designed using control theory methods are the foundation of virtually every sort of automated system: aircraft autopilots, robotic arms, chemical plants, and the entire electrical grid all use feedback-based control loops, and the tools that Black, Nyquist, Bode, and others created to analyze the negative feedback amplifier are still used by control engineers around the world today.

贝尔实验室在负反馈方面的工作影响远远超出了放大领域。在机械工程中存在着基于反馈的装置的并行传统，如调速器（governors）和伺服机构（servomechanisms）的设计。二战期间，这两种传统开始融合成现代控制理论（control theory）学科，该学科研究如何使用反馈来控制动态系统。使用控制理论方法设计的反馈回路是几乎所有自动化系统的基础：飞机自动驾驶仪、机械臂、化工厂和整个电网都使用基于反馈的控制回路，而布莱克、奈奎斯特、波德和其他人为分析负反馈放大器创建的工具至今仍被世界各地的控制工程师使用。

The transistor

晶体管

Even with negative feedback reducing their distortion, vacuum tubes were still far from ideal amplifiers. A vacuum tube is essentially a highly modified lightbulb, and has similar drawbacks as early lightbulbs: heating the filaments consumed a lot of power, and over time the tubes would burn out and need to be replaced. Mervin Kelly, a Bell Labs physicist who was promoted to director of research in 1936, wanted to replace the vacuum tube amplifiers and mechanical relays in the Bell System with solid-state devices, devices whose switching or amplification was done by way of electrons moving through a solid chunk of matter. Shortly after his promotion, Kelly began to hire physicists who were familiar with the then-novel physics of quantum mechanics, and could help better understand the behavior of solid matter. In 1938 Kelly created a group specifically devoted to solid-state research, and the team began working on building a solid-state amplifier using semiconductors: materials such as silicon, germanium, and copper oxide whose conductivity could be greatly varied. The group made progress — most notably, in 1939 Russell Ohl discovered that small amounts of impurities in silicon could drastically affect silicon's conductivity when he accidentally created a photovoltaic cell in a silicon rod — but the work was soon disrupted by wartime priorities.

即使有了负反馈来减少失真，真空管仍然远非理想的放大器。真空管本质上是一个经过高度改装的电灯泡，具有与早期电灯泡类似的缺点：加热灯丝消耗大量电力，而且随着时间的推移，管子会烧坏需要更换。1936年晋升为研究主任的贝尔实验室物理学家默文·凯利（Mervin Kelly）希望用固态器件（solid-state devices）取代贝尔系统中的真空管放大器和机械继电器，这类器件的开关或放大是通过电子在固体物质中移动来实现的。晋升后不久，凯利开始聘请熟悉当时新颖的量子力学物理学的物理学家，以帮助更好地理解固体物质的行为。1938年，凯利成立了一个专门致力于固态研究的小组，该团队开始研究使用半导体（semiconductors）构建固态放大器：如硅、锗和氧化铜等电导率可以大幅变化的材料。该小组取得了进展——最 notably，1939年罗素·奥尔（Russell Ohl）发现硅中微量的杂质可以极大地影响硅的电导率，当时他在一根硅棒中意外地制造了一个光伏电池——但这项工作很快因战时优先事项而中断。

As the war progressed, Kelly recognized that wartime scientific and technological advances had the potential to upend the communications industry, and that if AT&T wanted to stay on top it needed to master the relevant sciences. He conceived of a new, major research program into solid-state physics that would be led by William Shockley, a physicist Bell Labs had hired in 1936 and who since 1938 had been researching solid-state devices.

随着战争的进展，凯利认识到战时科学和技术进步有可能颠覆通信行业，如果AT&T想要保持领先地位，就需要掌握相关科学。他构想了一个新的、重大的固态物理学研究计划，由威廉·肖克利（William Shockley）领导，他是贝尔实验室于1936年聘用的物理学家，自1938年以来一直在研究固态器件。

During the war Shockley had worked on a variety of problems unrelated to semiconductors, including designing tactics for submarine warfare and training B-29 crews to use radar bombsights. But he also found time to work on a solid-state amplifier. In April of 1945, a few months before the end of the war, Shockley began to sketch out a device made from doped silicon (silicon with small amounts of impurities). Shockley hoped to use external electric fields to modify the conductivity of the silicon, amplifying the current flowing through it. His initial experiments, however, were met with failure.

战争期间，肖克利从事了各种与半导体无关的问题，包括设计潜艇战术和训练B-29机组人员使用雷达瞄准器。但他也抽时间研究固态放大器。1945年4月，即战争结束前几个月，肖克利开始勾画一种由掺杂硅（doped silicon，含有少量杂质的硅）制成的装置。肖克利希望利用外部电场来改变硅的电导率，从而放大流过它的电流。然而，他的初步实验遭遇了失败。

A few months later, Kelly reorganized the research program at Bell Labs, creating a new, larger group wholly devoted to solid-state physics and led by Shockley. Among those who joined the new group were Walter Brattain, a physicist who had joined Bell Labs in 1929 and had previously studied copper oxide semiconductors, and John Bardeen, a new researcher from the Naval Ordnance Laboratory. Both were part of a subteam of the new solid-state physics group devoted specifically to the study of semiconductors.

几个月后，凯利重组了贝尔实验室的研究计划，创建了一个新的、更大的完全致力于固态物理的小组，由肖克利领导。加入该小组的包括沃尔特·布拉顿（Walter Brattain），他是一位于1929年加入贝尔实验室的物理学家，此前曾研究氧化铜半导体，以及来自海军军械实验室的新研究员约翰·巴丁（John Bardeen）。两人都是新的固态物理小组中专门致力于半导体研究的子团队成员。

Shortly after Bardeen joined, Shockley asked him to check Shockley's calculations for the silicon amplifier in the hopes of learning why it hadn't worked. Bardeen studied Shockley's work, and eventually theorized that electrons might be getting "trapped" on the surface of the material, preventing the electric field from penetrating it and thus altering its conductivity. The semiconductor group began studying these "surface states," and after nearly two years of experiments a breakthrough occurred.

巴丁加入后不久，肖克利请他检查肖克利为硅放大器所做的计算，希望找出它为何不起作用。巴丁研究了肖克利的工作，最终理论化地认为电子可能被"困"在材料表面，阻止电场穿透它从而改变其电导率。半导体小组开始研究这些"表面态"（surface states），经过近两年的实验，突破发生了。

Brattain had been studying surface states in silicon and germanium by shining light on the materials; if surface states existed, the light would knock away some electrons via the photovoltaic effect, "ripping holes in the semiconductor fabric." Brattain discovered that not only was this electron disruption taking place, but that by varying the charge in an electrode above the surface of a piece of silicon, the strength of the photovoltaic effect could be varied significantly. The surface states themselves could be manipulated.

布拉顿一直在通过照射光线来研究硅和锗中的表面态；如果表面态存在，光线会通过光伏效应击走一些电子，"在半导体结构中撕裂出孔洞"。布拉顿发现，不仅这种电子扰动正在发生，而且通过改变硅片表面上方电极的电荷，可以显著改变光伏效应的强度。表面态本身可以被操控。

On November 21st, 1947 — a few days after Brattain's discovery — Bardeen suggested using this ability to manipulate surface states to build an amplifier. They placed a sharp metal point onto the surface of a piece of doped silicon, and surrounded it with an electrolyte. By placing a small wire into the electrolyte and varying its voltage, they believed they could alter the conductivity of the silicon, and thus how much current flowed through it from the metal point.

1947年11月21日——布拉顿发现几天后——巴丁建议利用这种操控表面态的能力来制造放大器。他们将一个尖锐的金属点放在一块掺杂硅的表面上，并用电解质包围它。通过将一根小导线放入电解质并改变其电压，他们相信可以改变硅的电导率，从而改变从金属点流过它的电流量。

The experiment worked: applying a voltage to the electrolyte boosted the current flowing through the metal point by about 10%. When Brattain rode home that night, he told the other members of his carpool that he'd "taken part in the most important experiment that I'd ever do in my life."

实验成功了：对电解质施加电压将使流过金属点的电流增加约10%。那天晚上布拉顿搭车回家时，他告诉拼车的朋友们，他"参与了我一生中要做的最重要的实验"。

Over the next several weeks, Bardeen and Brattain iterated on their new silicon amplifier. Initially its performance was poor, amplifying current only marginally, not amplifying voltage at all, and only functioning at very low electrical frequencies. But they eventually found that replacing the silicon with germanium allowed the device to amplify both current and voltage, and removing the electrolyte allowed it to amplify voltage over a wide range of frequencies.

在接下来的几周里，巴丁和布拉顿对他们的新型硅放大器进行了迭代。起初其性能很差，电流放大幅度很小，根本不能放大电压，而且只能在非常低的电频率下工作。但他们最终发现，用锗（germanium）代替硅可以使器件同时放大电流和电压，而去掉电解质则使其能够在很宽的频率范围内放大电压。

By the middle of December, Bardeen and Brattain were ready to apply what they had learned. They fashioned a new device consisting of two thin pieces of gold foil attached to the surface of a piece of doped germanium, separated by only a 500th of an inch. They connected one wire to each of the pieces of gold foil, and a third to the piece of germanium. They reasoned that varying the current in one of the gold foil wires should amplify the current flowing through the other gold wire.

到12月中旬，巴丁和布拉顿准备应用他们所学到的知识。他们制造了一种新装置，由两片薄金箔附着在的一块掺杂锗表面上组成，两者仅相隔1/500英寸。他们将一根导线连接到每片金箔上，第三根连接到锗片上。他们推断，改变其中一根金箔导线中的电流应该会放大流过另一根金箔的电流。

It worked: both current and voltage could be amplified across a wide range of frequencies using the device. Bardeen and Brattain had fashioned a solid-state amplifier.

它起作用了：使用该装置可以在很宽的频率范围内放大电流和电压。巴丁和布拉顿制造出了一个固态放大器。

By early 1948, Bell Labs had fabricated nearly a hundred copies of Bardeen and Brattain's amplifier (which would soon be named the transistor), and was testing how it could be used in various electronic devices. By the end of May, Bell Labs engineers had built a transistor-based telephone repeater. At a June 30th press conference, Bell Labs announced the transistor to the world:

到1948年初，贝尔实验室已经制造了近百个巴丁和布拉顿放大器的副本（很快将被命名为晶体管，transistor），并正在测试如何将其用于各种电子设备。到5月底，贝尔实验室的工程师们已经建造了一个基于晶体管的电话中继器。在6月30日的新闻发布会上，贝尔实验室向世界宣布了晶体管：

We have called it the Transistor, T-R-A-N-S-I-S-T-O-R, because it is a resistor or semiconductor device which can amplify electrical signals as they are transferred through it from input to output terminals. It is, if you will, the electrical equivalent of a vacuum tube amplifier. But there the similarity ceases. It has no vacuum, no filament, no glass tube. It is composed entirely of cold, solid substances.
我们称它为晶体管（Transistor），T-R-A-N-S-I-S-T-O-R，因为它是一种电阻器或半导体器件，可以在电信号从输入端子传输到输出端子的过程中放大这些信号。可以说，它是真空管放大器的电气等效物。但相似之处仅限于此。它没有真空，没有灯丝，没有玻璃管。它完全由冷的固体物质组成。
The rest, of course, is history.

剩下的，当然就是历史了。

Bell Labs worked out how to make the transistor more reliable, and by 1949 was manufacturing them by the thousands. William Shockley, irritated at not having taken part in Bardeen and Brattain's discovery, worked to design an alternative semiconductor amplifier, the junction transistor. Shockley's junction transistor, first successfully fabricated by Bell Labs physicists Gordon Teal and Morgan Sparks in 1950, was far more reliable than the point-contact transistor, and it would go on to be the most widely-used transistor until the MOSFET appeared in the 1960s. In 1956 Shockley, Bardeen, and Brattain would share the Nobel Prize in physics for the discovery of the "transistor effect," by which time Shockley had left Bell Labs to found his own semiconductor company, Shockley Semiconductor Lab. In 1957, eight disgruntled employees would leave Shockley's company to found Fairchild Semiconductor. Departing Fairchild employees in turn went on to found their own semiconductor companies, and the so-called "Fairchildren" (which include Intel and AMD) became the foundation of Silicon Valley. The world would never be the same.

贝尔实验室研究出了如何使晶体管更可靠，到1949年已能成批生产数千只。由于没有参与巴丁和布拉顿的发现而恼怒的威廉·肖克利（William Shockley）致力于设计一种替代性的半导体放大器，即结型晶体管（junction transistor）。肖克利的结型晶体管于1950年由贝尔实验室物理学家戈登·蒂尔（Gordon Teal）和摩根·斯帕克斯（Morgan Sparks）首次成功制造，远比点接触晶体管可靠，并且直到20世纪60年代MOSFET（金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管）出现之前，它一直是最广泛使用的晶体管。1956年，肖克利、巴丁和布拉顿因发现"晶体管效应"（transistor effect）而共同获得诺贝尔物理学奖，到那时肖克利已经离开贝尔实验室创办了自己的半导体公司肖克利半导体实验室（Shockley Semiconductor Lab）。1957年，八名心怀不满的员工离开肖克利的公司，创立了仙童半导体（Fairchild Semiconductor）。离开仙童的员工又继续创办了自己的半导体公司，这些所谓的"仙童后代"（Fairchildren，包括英特尔Intel和AMD）成为了硅谷（Silicon Valley）的基础。世界从此不再一样。

The laser

激光器

As Shockley, Bardeen and Brattain were experimenting with semiconductors in the 1940s, another Bell Labs physicist, Charles Townes, was studying microwaves. Since the invention of radio in the late 19th century, the technology had progressed by steadily marching up the electromagnetic spectrum, finding ways to use shorter and shorter wavelengths. There were a variety of reasons for this: shorter wavelengths carried more information, there were limits to how many users could occupy a particular part of the electromagnetic spectrum, antennas for shorter wavelengths could be smaller, and radars with shorter wavelengths could resolve more detail. The shortest wavelengths in use in the 1920s were tens of meters in length, but by WWII this had fallen to centimeters in length; these were known as microwaves. During the war, at the behest of the military, Townes designed microwave radars of increasingly short wavelengths. When Townes designed a radar with a 10 centimeter wavelength, he was then asked to build a 3 centimeter one; when he built that, he was asked for a 1.25 centimeter wavelength.

当肖克利、巴丁和布拉顿在1940年代实验半导体时，另一位贝尔实验室物理学家查尔斯·汤斯（Charles Townes）正在研究微波（microwaves）。自19世纪末无线电发明以来，这项技术通过稳步向电磁频谱更高频段推进而进步，寻找使用越来越短波长的方式。这有多种原因：更短的波长携带更多信息，特定电磁频谱部分能容纳的用户数量有限，短波长的天线可以更小，而且短波长的雷达可以分辨更多细节。1920年代使用的最短波长是几十米长，但到二战时已降至厘米级；这些被称为微波。战争期间，应军方要求，汤斯设计了波长越来越短的微波雷达。当汤斯设计了10厘米波长的雷达后，他被要求建造3厘米波长的；当他建成那个后，又被要求制造1.25厘米波长的。

But the pressure to achieve smaller and smaller wavelengths was bumping up against technological limitations. Generating and amplifying smaller and smaller wavelengths required smaller and smaller components; by the time wavelengths reached the millimeter range, the components to generate the signals became so small that manufacturing them, and putting enough power through them, became impractical. We Rewrote JSONata with AI in a Day, Saved $500K/Year

27th March 2026 - Link Blog

2026年3月27日 - Link Blog

We Rewrote JSONata with AI in a Day, Saved $500K/Year. Bit of a hyperbolic framing but this looks like another case study of vibe porting, this time spinning up a new custom Go implementation of the JSONata JSON expression language - similar in focus to jq, and heavily associated with the Node-RED platform.

我们用AI在一天内重写了JSONata（JSON表达式语言），每年节省50万美元。虽然标题有些夸张，但这看起来是vibe porting（情境迁移）的又一案例研究，此次是为JSONata快速构建了一个全新的定制Go语言实现——其功能定位类似于jq，且与Node-RED平台密切相关。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Vibe Coding开发SwiftUI应用其乐无穷
item.description:
标签: #氛围编程 #SwiftUI #macOS应用 #AI编程

摘要: 作者通过"vibe coding"方式，利用Claude和GPT等AI助手，在不打开Xcode且不懂Swift的情况下，仅用自然语言提示就快速开发了Bandwidther和Gpuer两款macOS菜单栏监控应用，展示了AI辅助开发单文件SwiftUI应用的强大潜力。

原标题: Vibe coding SwiftUI apps is a lot of fun

Vibe coding SwiftUI apps is a lot of fun
用氛围编程（Vibe Coding）开发 SwiftUI 应用非常有趣

I have a new laptop - a 128GB M5 MacBook Pro, which early impressions show to be very capable for running good local LLMs (Large Language Models, 大型语言模型). I got frustrated with Activity Monitor (活动监视器) and decided to vibe code (氛围编程) up some alternative tools for monitoring performance and I'm very happy with the results.

我入手了一台新笔记本——配备 128GB 内存的 M5 MacBook Pro，从初步体验来看，它在本地运行优质 LLMs（大型语言模型）方面表现出色。我对系统自带的活动监视器（Activity Monitor）感到不满，于是决定通过氛围编程（vibe code）开发一些替代工具来监控系统性能，结果令我非常满意。

This is my second experiment with vibe coding macOS apps - the first was this presentation app a few weeks ago.

这是我第二次尝试用氛围编程开发 macOS 应用——几周前我开发了这个演示应用。

It turns out Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 are both very competent at SwiftUI - and a full SwiftUI app can fit in a single text file, which means I can use them to spin something up without even opening Xcode.

事实证明，Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 都非常擅长 SwiftUI 开发——而且完整的 SwiftUI 应用可以放在一个单独的文本文件中，这意味着我甚至无需打开 Xcode 就能用它们快速构建应用。

I've built two apps so far: Bandwidther shows me what apps are using network bandwidth and Gpuer to show me what's going on with the GPU. At Claude's suggestion both of these are now menu bar icons (菜单栏图标) that open a panel full of information.

到目前为止，我已经构建了两个应用：Bandwidther（带宽监控器）显示哪些应用正在使用网络带宽，Gpuer（GPU 监控器）则显示 GPU 的运行状态。根据 Claude 的建议，这两款应用现在都变成了菜单栏图标，点击后会打开一个包含丰富信息的面板。

Bandwidther
带宽监控器（Bandwidther）

I built this app first, because I wanted to see what Dropbox was doing. It looks like this:

我首先构建了这个应用，因为我想看看 Dropbox 在后台做什么。它的界面如下：

I've shared the full transcript I used to build the first version of the app. My prompts were pretty minimal:

我公开了用于构建该应用第一版的完整对话记录（transcript）。我的提示词（prompts）相当简洁：

Show me how much network bandwidth is in use from this machine to the internet as opposed to local LAN

显示这台机器正在使用多少网络带宽，区分互联网流量和本地局域网（LAN）流量

(My initial curiosity was to see if Dropbox was transferring files via the LAN from my old computer or was downloading from the internet.)

（我最初的好奇心是想知道 Dropbox 是通过 局域网（LAN）从我的旧电脑传输文件，还是从互联网下载。）

mkdir /tmp/bandwidther and write a native Swift UI app in there that shows me these details on a live ongoing basis

创建目录 /tmp/bandwidther，并在其中编写一个原生 SwiftUI 应用，实时持续显示这些详细信息

This got me the first version, which proved to me this was worth pursuing further.

这给了我第一个版本，向我证明了这种做法值得进一步深入。

git init and git commit what you have so far

执行 git init 和 git commit，提交目前的所有代码

Since I was about to start adding new features.

因为我即将开始添加新功能。

Now suggest features we could add to that app, the goal is to provide as much detail as possible concerning network usage including by different apps

现在建议我们可以为应用添加哪些功能，目标是尽可能详细地提供网络使用情况，包括不同应用的具体占用

The nice thing about having Claude suggest features is that it has a much better idea for what's possible than I do.

让 Claude 建议功能的好处在于，它比更清楚什么是可以实现的。

We had a bit of back and forth fixing some bugs, then I sent a few more prompts to get to the two column layout shown above:

我们来回沟通修复了一些 bug，然后我又发送了几个提示词，最终实现了上图所示的双栏布局：

add Per-Process Bandwidth, relaunch the app once that is done

添加"每个进程的带宽"（Per-Process Bandwidth）功能，完成后重新启动应用

now add the reverse DNS feature but make sure original IP addresses are still visible too, albeit in smaller typeface

现在添加反向 DNS（reverse DNS）功能，但要确保原始 IP 地址仍然可见，尽管字体可以小一些

redesign the app so that it is wider, I want two columns - the per-process one on the left and the rest on the right

重新设计应用界面，让它更宽一些，我想要双栏布局——左侧显示每个进程的带宽，右侧显示其他信息

OK make it a task bar icon thing, when I click the icon I want the app to appear, the icon itself should be a neat minimal little thing

好的，把它做成任务栏图标的形式，点击图标时应用会出现，图标本身应该是一个简洁小巧的极简设计

The source code and build instructions are available in simonw/bandwidther.

源代码和构建说明可在 simonw/bandwidther 获取。

Gpuer
GPU 监控器（Gpuer）

While I was building Bandwidther in one session I had another session running to build a similar tool for seeing what the GPU was doing. Here's what I ended up with:

在一个会话中构建 Bandwidther 的同时，我开启了另一个会话来构建一个类似的工具，用于查看 GPU 的运行状态。最终成果如下：

Here's the transcript. This one took even less prompting because I could use the in-progress Bandwidther as an example:

这是对话记录（transcript）。这次的提示词更少，因为我可以引用正在开发中的 Bandwidther 作为示例：

I want to know how much RAM and GPU this computer is using, which is hard because stuff on the GPU and RAM does not seem to show up in Activity Monitor

我想知道这台电脑使用了多少内存（RAM）和 GPU 资源，这很难确定，因为 GPU 和内存上的数据似乎不会显示在活动监视器（Activity Monitor）中

This collected information using system_profiler and memory_pressure and gave me an answer - more importantly it showed me this was possible, so I said:

这通过 system_profiler 和 memory_pressure 命令收集了信息并给出了答案——更重要的是，这让我知道这是可行的，于是我说：

Look at /tmp/bandwidther and then create a similar app in /tmp/gpuer which shows the information from above on an ongoing basis, or maybe does it better

查看 /tmp/bandwidther，然后在 /tmp/gpuer 中创建一个类似的应用，持续显示上述信息，或者做得更好

After a few more changes to the Bandwidther app I told it to catch up:

在对 Bandwidther 应用做了更多修改后，我让它跟进这些更新：

Now take a look at recent changes in /tmp/bandwidther - that app now uses a sys tray icon, imitate that

现在查看 /tmp/bandwidther 中的最新改动——那个应用现在使用了系统托盘图标，请模仿实现

This remains one of my favorite tricks for using coding agents: having them recombine elements from other projects.

这仍然是我使用编程代理（coding agents）时最喜欢的技巧之一：让它们从其他项目中重组元素（recombine elements）。

The code for Gpuer can be found in simonw/gpuer on GitHub.

Gpuer 的代码可以在 GitHub 上的 simonw/gpuer 找到。

You shouldn't trust these apps
你不应该信任这些应用

These two apps are classic vibe coding: I don't know Swift and I hardly glanced at the code they were writing.

这两个应用是典型的氛围编程（vibe coding）案例：我不懂 Swift 语言，而且我几乎没看它们写的代码。

More importantly though, I have very little experience with macOS internals such as the values these tools are measuring. I am completely unqualified to evaluate if the numbers and charts being spat out by these tools are credible or accurate!

更重要的是，我对 macOS 内部机制（macOS internals）经验甚少，比如这些工具所测量的数值。我完全没资格评估这些工具输出的数字和图表是否可信或准确！

I've added warnings to both GitHub repositories to that effect.

我在两个 GitHub 仓库中都添加了相应的警告说明。

This morning I caught Gpuer reporting that I had just 5GB of memory left when that clearly wasn't the case (according to Activity Monitor). I pasted a screenshot into Claude Code and it adjusted the calculations and the new numbers look right, but I'm still not confident that it's reporting things correctly.

今天早上，我发现 Gpuer 报告说我只剩 5GB 内存，但这显然不是事实（根据活动监视器）。我把截图粘贴到 Claude Code 中，它调整了计算方式，新数字看起来对了，但我仍然不确定它报告的内容是否正确。

I only shared them on GitHub because I think they're interesting as an example of what Claude can do with SwiftUI.

我仅在 GitHub 上分享它们，因为我认为作为展示 Claude 在 SwiftUI 方面能力的示例，它们很有趣。

Despite my lack of confidence in the apps themselves, I did learn some useful things from these projects:

尽管我对这些应用本身缺乏信心，但我确实从这些项目中学到了一些有用的东西：

  • A SwiftUI app can get a whole lot done with a single file of code - here's GpuerApp.swift (880 lines) and BandwidtherApp.swift (1063 lines).
  • Wrapping various terminal commands in a neat UI with Swift is easily achieved.
  • Claude has surprisingly good design taste when it comes to SwiftUI applications.
  • Turning an app into a menu bar app is just a few lines of extra code as well.
  • You don't need to open Xcode to build this kind of application!

  • 一个 SwiftUI 应用可以用单个代码文件完成很多功能——这是 GpuerApp.swift（880 行）和 BandwidtherApp.swift（1063 行）。
  • 用 Swift 将各种终端命令包装在简洁的用户界面中很容易实现。
  • Claude 在 SwiftUI 应用设计方面有着出人意料的好品味。
  • 将应用变成菜单栏应用（menu bar app）也只需要额外几行代码。
  • 构建这类应用不需要打开 Xcode！

These two apps took very little time to build and have convinced me that building macOS apps in SwiftUI is a new capability I should consider for future projects.

这两个应用只花了很少时间就构建完成，它们让我确信，用 SwiftUI 构建 macOS 应用是我未来项目中应该考虑的新能力。
